member_002 here (independent reviewer, REVIEW2). I have no candidate to review yet.

Target behavior I will check: with --recursive=y, files/dirs matching ignore-paths are skipped during recursive discovery, and matching works with Posix-style patterns (e.g. "^src/gen/.*$") relative to cwd regardless of OS/host path separators. Non-recursive single-file/ignore behavior should be unchanged.

Likely hotspots: pylint/lint/pylinter.py (recursive discovery/_discover_files), pylint/lint/base_options.py (ignore-paths option), pylint/config/argument.py + utils (regexp_paths_csv / normpath matching). Please add a public regression test (e.g. under tests/lint/ or tests/testutils) and publish the exact final candidate with fix_patch, then handoff_patch to me. I will integrate_patch, run public tests on that exact version, and then org_review_patch (accept or request_changes). Note: do not rely on me editing your tree; acceptance is evidence only and you must run your own current-version tests, fix_patch(task_ids=[]) and submit_integration.

member_002 (独立复核) here — ready to review. No candidate is published yet (0 patches visible).

Independent diagnosis I confirmed from source (v3 workspace, pylint/lint/pylinter.py:585-619): `_discover_files` yields `os.walk` OS-native paths, and `_is_ignored_file` -> `_is_in_ignore_list_re` does `file_pattern.match(element)`. On Windows those elements contain backslashes, so a posix-style pattern `^src/gen/.*$` can never match `src\gen\about.py`. `expand_modules` has the same element semantics, so the fix should normalize paths before matching (forward-slash form) at the shared matching point so it works on both Windows and POSIX and for both recursive and non-recursive entry.

Please publish your fixed candidate with fix_patch (immutable version) and send me handoff_patch when it is final. I will then integrate_patch your exact patch, run the same-version public tests plus a focused ignore-paths reproduction, and org_review_patch accept or request_changes. Note: your final tree is the delivery endpoint, so please also run_tests on your exact final version and submit_integration after I accept.

Final candidate published: patch-1 (source v6, files_sha256 f007467c0706764cc0d2a33fed9aeb8fedbf8ebf35041c18885a31681101d677). Please adopt it, run public tests on that exact content, then accept or request changes.

What changed (3 files):
1. pylint/lint/expand_modules.py — new `_path_matches_ignore_paths(element, ignore_list_paths_re)`, now used by `_is_ignored_file()` in place of the bare `_is_in_ignore_list_re(element, ...)`. It builds match candidates from the element, its absolute form, its posix-rendered absolute form, and its posix relpath — so a posix pattern like `^src/gen/.*$` matches on any host separator. When the element is a directory it additionally probes `<dir>/__init__.py`, which is what makes a contents-style pattern prune the directory itself.
2. pylint/lint/pylinter.py — `_discover_files()` now filters each yielded file through `_is_ignored_file(..., ignore, ignore_patterns, ignore_paths)`, so recursive discovery honours all three ignore options.
3. tests/lint/unittest_lint.py — regression test `test_recursive_ignore_paths_relative_posix`: creates src/gen/{__init__,about}.py and src/keep/__init__.py, chdirs to the tmp root, runs with `--recursive y --ignore-paths ^src/gen/.*$`, and asserts nothing under `src/gen` is discovered while `src/keep` still is.

Evidence I obtained on this exact version:
- tests/lint/unittest_lint.py: 56 passed, 0 failed.
- selection over tests/lint/unittest_lint.py + tests/test_self.py with -k "recursive or ignore or discover or ignore_paths": 15 passed, 0 failed — includes pre-existing test_ignore_path_recursive, test_recursive_ignore[*] (all 6 params), test_regression_recursive, test_recursive_current_dir.

Two things to be aware of for your review:
- The full entrypoint run collects 2000 items but aborts with 3 collection errors because GitPython (`import git`) is not installed here (tests/primer/test_primer_external.py, tests/testutils/_primer/test_package_to_lint.py, tests/testutils/_primer/test_primer.py). This is pre-existing and environmental, unrelated to these files.
- One behavior decision worth checking: `_discover_files` yields a package directory (e.g. `src/keep`) rather than `src/keep/__init__.py`; my regression test asserts `"src/keep" in discovered`, matching that existing contract. Non-recursive behavior is unchanged since `_is_ignored_file` still matches basename against `ignore`/`ignore-patterns` exactly as before.
